summary.en: Tutorial guidance, the Historian's tales, and other odds and ends.
summary.zh: 新手引导、历史学家的讲述，以及其他零散剧情。

briefing.zh: 失去了 Kanta 的保护

texts.en:
The comm-link flickers, freezes, and restarts as your comms protocols align with whatever the pirate is using.

The pirate $rank appears, a smug look already emplaced. "Captain $playerName. I am here on behalf of her mercilessness, Warlord Kanta. It is her wish that you know that her many eyes are watching you."

$HeOrShe smiles, displaying teeth filed to points. "That is all."
texts.zh:
在通讯链接闪断定格并重启了好几次之后，你的通讯器才匹配上了海盗用的不知啥鬼玩意通信协议。

海盗 $rank 出现在了画面上，洋洋得意的神情溢于言表。" $playerName 舰长，我代表无情的军阀 Kanta 来这。那位大人希望你明白她有许多双眼睛在注视着你。"

$HeOrShe微笑着，露出被锉尖的牙齿。"就是这些。"

texts.en:
The comm-link flickers as it establishes the connection. Error codes flash by - outdated protocols and unauthorized modifications.

The pirate $rank appears, arms crossed. "Captain $playerName. I bring you greetings from the Warlord Kanta, mighty and ruthless. She has been watching your career and is pleased that you are prospering under her protection agreement."

This must be about the agreement you made, to do Kanta a 'favor' in exchange for her protection.
texts.zh:
通讯频道闪烁着建立了链接。面前各类报错信号闪烁不停，似乎是因为过期的程式协定以及未经许可的改装。

海盗 $rank 出现在频道里，双臂抱胸。" $playerName 舰长。强大以及残酷的 Kanta 军阀吩咐我向你带来问候。她一直关注着你的生涯，也很欣慰你能在她的保护下繁荣昌盛。"

这必然是关于之前你做的约定，卖 Kanta 一个 '人情' 以获得她的保护。

texts.en:
The comm-link flickers, freezes, and restarts as your comms protocols align with whatever the pirate is using.

The pirate $rank appears, a smug look already emplaced. "Captain $playerName. I am here on behalf of her mercilessness, Warlord Kanta. It is her wish that you know her many eyes are watching over you."

$HeOrShe smiles, displaying teeth filed to points. "That is all."
texts.zh:
在通讯链接闪断定格并重启了好几次之后，你的通讯器才匹配上了海盗用的不知啥鬼玩意通信协议。

海盗 $rank 出现在了画面上，洋洋得意的神情溢于言表。" $playerName 舰长，我代表无情的军阀 Kanta 来这。那位大人希望你明白她有许多双眼睛在注视着你。"

$HeOrShe微笑着，露出被锉尖的牙齿。"就是这些。"

texts.en:
The comm-link flickers as it establishes the connection. Some error codes flash by, something about outdated protocols and unauthorized modifications.

The pirate $rank appears, arms crossed. "Captain $playerName. I bring you greetings from the Warlord Kanta. She has been watching your career and is pleased that you are prospering under her protection agreement."
texts.zh:
通讯频道闪烁着建立了链接。面前各类报错信号闪烁不停，似乎是因为过期的程式协定以及未经许可的改装。

海盗 $rank 出现在频道里，双臂抱胸。" $playerName 舰长。强大以及残酷的 Kanta 军阀吩咐我向你带来问候。她一直关注着你的生涯，也很欣慰你能在她的保护下繁荣昌盛。"

texts.en: You cut the comm link.
texts.zh: 你切断了通讯链接。

texts.en: You cut the comm link.
texts.zh: 你切断了通讯链接。

texts.en: "The Warlord Kanta wishes for you to perform a tactical bombardment," $heOrShe glances at a battered datapad, "on the military base of $affk_marketName. This shall demonstrate that none who cross Kanta may escape her reach!"
texts.zh: "军阀 Kanta 想要你执行一次战术轰炸。" $heOrShe看向一个残破不堪的数据平板。"目标是 $affk_marketName 的军事基地。这将向所有人证明，任何与 Kanta 为敌的人都无法逃脱她的制裁！"

options.en: It is my pleasure to fulfill the Warlord's wishes. (accept)
options.zh: 能为军阀效劳是我的荣幸。 (接受)

options.en: No, there has to be some alternative. (decline)
options.zh: 不，肯定还有其他办法。 (拒绝)

options.en: Are you mad? Bombard $affk_marketName? It's suicide. (decline)
options.zh: 你疯了？轰炸 $affk_marketName？这是自杀。 (拒绝)

texts.en: "Of course you will," $heOrShe says, "For when Kanta demands blood, she will have blood. One way or another."
texts.zh: "你当然得干。" $heOrShe说道，"Kanta 要流血，便总得有人要流血。"

texts.en:
Kanta's minion transfers you the relevant data to perform the operation: a cursory nav entry providing no useful tactical info, a quick skim tells you. Your approach is all up to you. It would definitely be prudent to launch the attack with your transponder off, for starters...

$HeOrShe bares $hisOrHer protruding diamond canines - a hot look among certain crowds, you're sure. "Remember to have fun," $heOrShe says, then cuts the link.
texts.zh:
Kanta 的手下将行动相关信息转交给你：一个简单的坐标，没有任何有用的战术信息。简单看过后你认为实际的操作方式全看你自己的安排。当然，攻击时关掉应答器肯定是上策...

$HeOrShe露出了自己的钻石尖牙 —— 你估计这玩意在某些团体里是种热门的造型。"记得玩得高兴。" $heOrShe说道，随后切断了链接。

texts.en: "I am certain," $heOrShe says, "That Kanta will herself be most pleased by the blood and ruin you create for her."
texts.zh: "我敢肯定，" $heOrShe说到。"Kanta 将会对你为她所造成的鲜血和毁灭而满意的。"

texts.en:
The pirate puts on a look of concern, probably false. "This is not a negotiation, captain. The Warlord demands blood and ruin, so it you will provide."

"It comes either from $affk_marketName, or from you," $heOrShe casually drops $hisOrHer datapad. "The choice is yours."
texts.zh:
海盗装出了一副担忧的模样。"这不是在谈判，舰长。军阀要求鲜血与毁灭，所以你必须奉上。"

"这要么来自 $affk_marketName，要么来自你。" $heOrShe随手丢开了$hisOrHer的数据平板。"选择权在你。"

options.en: Assert that you decline Kanta's demand
options.zh: 坚持拒绝 Kanta 的要求

texts.en:
"More's the pity," the pirate says coldly, drawing the line of a tear down $hisOrHer face.

The comms cut to a distorted skull overlaid on scenes of ultraviolence; a common affectation of dedicated, professional pirates.
texts.zh:
"那还真是可惜了。" 海盗冷声说道，一边用手指在自己脸上划出一道泪痕。

通讯画面切换成一个扭曲的骷髅标志，覆盖在极端暴力的画面之上；这是那些专注且专业的海盗惯用的装点手法。

texts.en:
The pirate looks amused. "There is not," $heOrShe shrugs with feigned calm.

"What Kanta demands, Kanta gets. Our choice is whether to stand in the way of her rage - to what, prove something? It proves nothing. This is the way of the Persean Sector, captain."

"So," $heOrShe taps a short rhythm on $hisOrHer control console. "If it is suicide you think will result, then Kanta can provide your death just as well as some faction-navy. Choose."
texts.zh:
海盗看上去被逗乐了。"没别的办法。" $heOrShe假装冷静的耸了耸肩。

"Kanta 需要，Kanta 得到。我们的选择要么是挡在她的愤怒前来 —— 来干嘛？证明什么？什么都证明不了。在英仙座星域就是这么做事的，舰长。"

"所以" $heOrShe在$hisOrHer的控制台上按了几下。"如果你觉得最后会是自杀，那 Kanta 就和那些势力的海军一样能让你死。选吧。"

texts.en: The pirate produces a thin, mocking smile which displays $hisOrHer sharpened teeth.
texts.zh: 海盗讥笑一声，露出$hisOrHer的尖牙。

texts.en: The pirate produces a thin, mocking smile which displays $hisOrHer sharpened teeth, and says "No, that's not 'it', captain."
texts.zh: 海盗讥笑一声，露出$hisOrHer的尖牙，说到。"不，不是 '就这样'，舰长。"

texts.en:
"Nothing," $heOrShe says. "Yet."

The pirate flashes a sharp-toothed smile, diamond canines flashing, then hits the comms cutoff.
texts.zh:
"没什么。" $heOrShe说到，"现在还没。"

海盗咧着钻石尖牙笑了下，随后按下了通讯中断按钮。

texts.en:
"Yes," $heOrShe says, unamused at your flippant remark, "You should be thankful. You have been spared the Warlord Kanta's thirst for blood and ruin. For now."

$HeOrShe leans in, "When that thirst awakens, you will provide her with what she demands." The pirate flashes a sharp-toothed smile, diamond canines flashing, "One way, or another."

$HeOrShe hits the comms cutoff.
texts.zh:
"是的。" $heOrShe说到，明显对你轻率的回复不以为然。"你该感到庆幸。军阀 Kanta 目前还没打算从你这里满足她对流血和毁灭的饥渴。"

$HeOrShe倾向屏幕。"等那饥渴来临，你会给与她她所求之物的。" 海盗咧着闪光的钻石尖牙笑了下。"不论怎样都会。"

$HeOrShe敲下了通讯中断按钮。

texts.en: Neriene pauses a moment, then says "Before you go through with this, would you like to take a few practice swings to warm up?"
texts.zh: Neriene 停顿了一阵，然后开口道，"在开始之前，要不要先挥几下试试？"

options.en: I won't have them think me a coward.
options.zh: 我不会让他们把我当成懦夫的。

options.en: What do you mean by people like Cardona?
options.zh: 你说' Cardona 那样的人'是什么意思？
你们这儿的传统还真迷人。

options.en: I have studied the blade. (easier fight)
options.zh: 我略懂击剑。 (战斗难度降低)

options.en: Take a few practice swings (sword tutorial)
You're right, this is stupid. I'm leaving.
options.zh: 你说得对，这太蠢了，我要走了。

texts.en:
"If you're sure," she says.

As you begin to step away, she adds "And... give him hell!"
texts.zh:
"如果你确定的话。" 她说道。

当你迈步离开时，她补了一句，"顺便...给他点颜色看看！"

texts.en:
Dressed in dueling gear and wielding Neriene's sword, you are led to one end of a columned loggia that seems to hang over the valley below.

Magnus Cardona steps forward, and the crowds withdraw.
texts.zh:
披挂好决斗装备之后，你握起 Neriene 的剑，跟着领路人走到了一条长廊的尽头。长廊被高耸的立柱支起，看起来仿佛是悬在峡谷之上。

Magnus Cardona 踏步上前，人群向后退去。

texts.en: Neriene sighs, "It doesn't matter what those children think. I just can't believe grandmother is allowing this to go on. Emboldening people like Cardona is going to cause trouble."
texts.zh: Neriene 叹了口气，"没必要和那些孩子较真。我只是不敢相信，祖母居然会允许这件事发生。纵容 Cardona 那样的人只会带来麻烦。"

texts.en:
"It's, um. Complicated. Political." She doesn't like to talk about it, you think.

"There are those in the Hegemony that think they - we, I mean; those whose families came from the officers of the Fourteenth Battlegroup - that we're somehow better than everyone else. It's ridiculous."
texts.zh:
"这，嗯。很复杂，政治因素。" 看起来她不太愿意谈这个。

"霸主 中有些人是 第十四战斗群 的后裔，他们认为他们...不，应该说是我们，比其他任何人都强。但这太荒谬了。"

texts.en:
"One that has no place in a civilized society," she says. "But I suppose we aren't quite that, are we."

She looks toward one of the mirrorsets.
texts.zh:
"那东西在文明社会里根本没有用武之地。但看来我们还没文明到那个程度，不是吗？"

她这么说到，目光看向其中一套恒星镜组。

texts.en:
She hands you the scabbard with the sword, "This was given to me by my father."

"But it doesn't have any sentimental value." She gives you a quick look, "I never cared for swordplay."
texts.zh:
她把剑连鞘一起递给了你，"这是我父亲给我的。"

"但这没什么情感价值在里边，" 她瞥了一眼你的表情，"我不怎么喜欢剑术。"

texts.en:
Neriene looks doubtful as she hands you the scabbard.

You draw the blade in a single movement and demonstrate a lunge or two. The crowd gathering around you cheers and calls boasts toward the other end of the loggia.

"Those idiots might have made a bigger mistake than I thought," she admits with an impressed look.
texts.zh:
Neriene 把剑递你的时候看起来还有些将信将疑。

你干脆利落地拔剑出鞘，比划了个凌厉的弓步直刺，快得没法看清是出手了一次还是两次。聚在你周围的人群欢呼雀跃起来，还向走廊另一端发出吹嘘的声音。

"那些白痴犯了比我想象中更大的错误。" 她看起来承认了你有些本事。

texts.en: "Good," she says, and drops the scabbard onto the pile of dueling kit.
texts.zh: "很好，" 她说着，把剑扔到了那堆决斗用具里。

texts.en: The crowd jeers. Neriene gives the closest hecklers a killing look; they quickly discover that they were less enthusiastic about this duel than they had thought. Her status as a member of House Rao and host of the ball does not shield you from general disdain, however, and she quickly leads you through a discreet servants' access lift and back to your shuttle's pad.
texts.zh: 人群哄笑起来。随着 Neriene 向旁边咧嘴大笑的人投去了一个杀气腾腾的眼神，他们很快就识趣地发现了自己对这场决斗的热情没有想象中那么高。虽然身为 Rao 家的一员和舞会主持人，她并不能替你挡下所有的蔑视，但尽其所能地，她指引你进入了一个不起眼的侍者专用电梯，让你回到了你穿梭机的停泊处。

texts.en:
The staff is efficient; your entourage is summoned without requiring your intervention, though they seem to have been interrupted in the middle of a meal, wiping hands and one guard popping an anti-inebriant.

Shuttle prepped, Neriene sees you off from the launch pad.

"Well," she says uncomfortably, "I apologize for... for everything. We're not all clannish brutes."
texts.zh:
这里的员工效率很高；不需要你的提醒，他们就招来了你的随从。不过他们应该是饭才吃到一半的时候被叫出来的，全都还在擦着手。有个保镖还在你面前磕了一片醒酒药。

穿梭机已经准备就绪，Neriene 在发射台送别你。

"总之，" 她听上去一点都高兴不起来，"我为... 这一切向你道歉。我们并不都是排外的野蛮人。"

options.en: I won't hold their actions against you.
options.zh: 我不会因为他们的行为指责你。

options.en: I've survived worse. It's no hull breach, for instance.
options.zh: 我见过更糟的。这次又不是船上破了个洞，打个比方。

options.en: I enjoyed the dance. We should do it again.
options.zh: 至少我觉得跳舞挺有趣的，有机会我们该再试试。

options.en: Don't. They just showed me what you really are.
options.zh: 别装了，他们只不过是让我看到了你们的真面目而已。

texts.en:
She nods, accepting your words, her face still grim.

"Until a better time, captain."

She turns away before you can reply, heading toward the manor complex.
texts.zh: 她点点头，接受了你的话，但脸色依旧不好看。"再择良日吧，舰长。" 你还没来得及回答，她就转身朝庄园走了回去。

texts.en: Your shuttle rejoins your $shipOrFleet above $entityName.
texts.zh: 你的穿梭机返回了 $entityName 上方的$shipOrFleet中。

texts.en:
"No, I suppose not," she says, the start of a smile on her face.

"Until a better time, captain," she says then turns away before you can reply, heading toward the manor complex.
texts.zh: "嗯，确实。" 她说，脸上笑容重现，"再择良日吧，舰长。"你还没来得及回答，她就转身朝庄园建筑群走了回去。

texts.en:
"I'd like that," she says, the start of a smile on her face.

She looks like she is about to say more, but instead nods quickly and turns away before you can reply, heading toward the manor complex.
texts.zh: "我也这么想，" 她说，脸上笑容重现。她看起来还想说什么，但取而代之地，她点了点头后转身朝庄园建筑群走了回去 —— 在你能做出答复之前。

texts.en: She looks hurt, opens her mouth to speak, then closes it and quickly turns away, heading toward the manor complex.
texts.zh: 她看起来受到了不小的打击，张开嘴想说些什么，但很快一言不发地闭上嘴，转身朝庄园建筑群走了回去。

texts.en:
$marketName fills your bridge tactical display, a spatter of hollowed icons representing dead targets. The last one blinks out. This should make the Warlord Kanta happy, if she is even capable of that emotion anymore.

You wave a hand to collapse the tactical display, and it winks out obediently. The holomatrix snows then reforms a navigational overview, your $shipOrFleet holding station in the center.
texts.zh:
$marketName 占满了你的舰桥战术显示界面，代表目标被击毁的空心图标不断飞溅而出。随着最后一个目标熄灭，这该能让军阀 Kanta 高兴了，如果她还能有那种感情的话。

你轻轻挥手，战术显示界面随之折叠关闭。四散的全息噪点随后重聚成了导航总览界面，你的$shipOrFleet正稳稳驻留在画面正中央。

texts.en:
$name fills your bridge tactical display, a spatter of hollowed icons representing dead targets. The last one blinks out, and with that your mission parameters are fulfilled.

With a simple wave of your hand the tactical display collapses and winks out. The holomatrix snows and reforms a navigational overview, your $shipOrFleet holding station in the very center.
texts.zh:
$name 占满了你的舰桥战术显示界面，代表目标被击毁的空心图标不断飞溅而出。当最后一个图标出现之后，你的任务完成了。

你轻轻挥手，战术显示界面随之折叠关闭。四散的全息噪点随后重聚成了导航总览界面，你的$shipOrFleet正稳稳驻留在画面正中央。

texts.en:
$marketName fills your bridge tactical display, a spatter of hollowed icons representing dead targets. The last one blinks out. This should make the Warlord Kanta happy, if she is even capable of that emotion anymore.

You wave a hand to collapse the tactical display, and it winks out obediently. The holomatrix snows then reforms a navigational overview, your $shipOrFleet holding station in the center.

$marketName 占满了你的舰桥战术显示界面，代表目标被击毁的空心图标不断飞溅而出。随着最后一个目标熄灭，这该能让军阀 Kanta 高兴了，如果她还能有那种感情的话。

你轻轻挥手，战术显示界面随之折叠关闭。四散的全息噪点随后重聚成了导航总览界面，你的$shipOrFleet正稳稳驻留在画面正中央。
